articles.headline: Kejriwal defends Siddaramaiah, hits out at BJP in national interest
articles.blurb: AAP leader Arvind Kejriwal backed Chief Minister Siddaramaiah after the Karnataka High Court struck down a provision of the MAHITI Act, saying nationalism is not the BJP's monopoly and accusing the party of using agencies against opponents.

articles.headline: Railways cancel train services near to Diwali festival
articles.blurb: South Western Railway cancelled or short-terminated several trains ahead of Diwali, including Mangaluru–Vasco, Yesvantpur–Karwar, Karwar–Yesvantpur and other services listed in the paper for the festival period.

articles.headline: Bajrang Dal activists claim Kozhikode idols taken away to temple
articles.blurb: Bajrang Dal workers in Kozhikode alleged that idols from a local temple were removed and taken elsewhere, demanding action and staging protests over the claim.

articles.headline: Centre urged to consider renaming Mangaluru International Airport
articles.blurb: Stakeholders urged the Union government to rename Mangaluru International Airport after a prominent local figure, arguing the current name does not reflect the region's heritage and identity.

articles.headline: Curry leaves from Mangaluru and surrounding areas have now reached Singapore
articles.blurb: Exports of curry leaves grown around Mangaluru have begun reaching Singapore, with traders citing improved cold-chain handling and new overseas demand for the coastal produce.

articles.headline: MUDA floats fresh property rates for MSEZ areas around Mangaluru
articles.blurb: Mangaluru Urban Development Authority notified revised guidance values and property rates for plots in and around the Mangaluru Special Economic Zone, affecting registrations and building approvals.

articles.headline: Host third edition of Bio Advantage Karnataka Trade fair soon
articles.blurb: Organisers said the third Bio Advantage Karnataka trade fair will be held in Mangaluru shortly, showcasing biotech, pharma and agri-processing firms from the coast and state.

articles.headline: KSRTC on the move to instal CCTV cameras in running buses
articles.blurb: Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation plans to install CCTV cameras in running buses to improve passenger safety and aid investigation of incidents on long-distance routes.

articles.headline: Annual Bhoota Naivedya ritual draws devotees at Kasargod
articles.blurb: Devotees gathered for the annual Bhoota Naivedya ritual at Kasargod, with traditional offerings and cultural performances marking the coastal Theyyam-related observance.

articles.headline: Do not stress, just follow the rules strictly within the bounds of law
articles.blurb: Officials asked traders and the public to comply strictly with Karnataka's single-use plastic ban, warning inspections and penalties while urging calm adherence rather than panic buying of alternatives.

articles.headline: Blood donation camp held in Mangaluru on Wednesday under Rotary Blood Storage Centre
articles.blurb: Rotary Blood Storage Centre, Mangaluru, organised a blood donation camp on Wednesday, collecting units from donors to replenish stocks for city hospitals.

articles.headline: Admission process open for 2025-26 batch at KSUCMA Mangaluru
articles.blurb: Karnataka State Dr. Gangubai Hangal Music and Performing Arts University, Mangaluru, opened admissions for the 2025-26 academic batch across its music and dance programmes.

articles.headline: Former Union Minister Veerappa Moily to celebrate 95th birthday on Friday
articles.blurb: Former Union minister and senior Congress leader M. Veerappa Moily will mark his 95th birthday on Friday, with party workers and well-wishers planning felicitation events in Karnataka.

articles.headline: Another 2 farmers commit suicide, loan waiver a non-starter
articles.blurb: Two more farmers in Hassan district died by suicide amid crop and debt distress, as the paper noted that promised loan waivers have not materialised for many cultivators in the region.

articles.headline: Matriculation schools decide to introspect
articles.blurb: Mangalore Diocesan Board of Education matriculation schools resolved to introspect on academic standards and administration after recent discussions among principals and management representatives.

articles.headline: Mohammed Dawood bags second prize in culture quiz competition held in Mangaluru
articles.blurb: Student Mohammed Dawood won second prize in a culture quiz competition held in Mangaluru, testing participants on Karnataka and national heritage topics.

articles.headline: Woman and daughter cruelly murdered by husband & father-in-law
articles.blurb: Police in Hassan district arrested a man and his father after a woman and her daughter were found murdered; investigators said the accused confessed to killing them over a family dispute.

articles.headline: Returning from gulf in droves in search of jobs, question emigration policy
articles.blurb: Large numbers of Gulf returnees in Udupi district are struggling to find local employment, prompting community leaders to question whether emigration policies adequately prepare workers for reintegration.

articles.headline: Watch out for counterfeit products on sale at AYUSH expo
articles.blurb: Authorities cautioned visitors to Bengaluru's AYUSH expo to verify product labels after reports of counterfeit ayurvedic and herbal items being sold at some stalls.

articles.headline: Revenue dept allows access to commercial tax rates at low fee for Namma Mangaluru cardholders
articles.blurb: Mangaluru revenue officials said holders of the Namma Mangaluru civic card can obtain commercial-tax rate information for a nominal fee through a simplified counter service.

articles.headline: Dempos PU college celebrated Patnaik's 100th birth anniversary in grand scale
articles.blurb: Dempo Pre-University College marked the centenary of Biju Patnaik's birth with cultural programmes, speeches and a photo exhibition on the Odia leader's life.

articles.headline: Heritage trail walk in old Puttur town soon
articles.blurb: Puttur municipality and heritage volunteers will lead a guided walk through old Puttur town, highlighting colonial-era buildings, temples and market streets.

articles.headline: Dr Jayaprakash PU College at Puttur to celebrate diamond jubilee
articles.blurb: Dr Jayaprakash Pre-University College, Puttur, will celebrate its 60th year with alumni meets, cultural events and an honour roll for long-serving faculty.

articles.headline: Tuition mafia has reached its nadir with NEP regarding coaching for CLAT, CTET examinations
articles.blurb: A columnist argues that coaching centres are exploiting National Education Policy-linked entrance exams such as CLAT and CTET, turning competitive-test preparation into a costly 'tuition mafia' that burdens students and families.

articles.headline: Chennai Super Kings likely to enter Mangaluru as another franchise for IPL 2025
articles.blurb: Reports in the paper said Chennai Super Kings are exploring a Mangaluru-linked franchise entry for IPL 2025, which would expand the league's coastal Karnataka footprint if approved by BCCI.

articles.headline: Lecturers have to fight tooth and nail to secure their pay scale
articles.blurb: Government college lecturers in Karnataka said they continue lengthy struggles with the finance department to secure promised pay-scale revisions and arrears.

articles.headline: Alva's medalists honoured
articles.blurb: Alva's Education Foundation, Moodabidri, felicitated students who won medals in state and national sports and cultural competitions at a campus ceremony.

articles.headline: Spirit, reckless driving main cause of road mishaps in Puttur
articles.blurb: Puttur traffic police cited drunk driving and reckless riding as leading causes of recent accidents on NH-75 and town roads, announcing intensified checks during the festive season.

articles.headline: Devotees flock to historic Krishna Temple at Udupi ahead of Navaratri
articles.blurb: Thousands visited the Sri Krishna Math in Udupi ahead of Navaratri, with temple authorities arranging additional queues and sevas for the nine-night festival.

articles.headline: GSB Sabha to hold celebrations on the occasion of Oct jayanthi
articles.blurb: Goud Saraswat Brahmin Sabha, Mangaluru, will hold cultural and religious programmes to mark October jayanthi observances at its hall with community leaders invited.

articles.headline: MWSA, Ujire to hold inter club foot ball tournament
articles.blurb: Manipal West Sports Association, Ujire, will host an inter-club football tournament with teams from colleges and local clubs competing over several evenings.

articles.headline: MIPT on the move to introduce syllabus at Kengeri
articles.blurb: Manipal Institute of Technology plans to roll out revised engineering syllabi at its Kengeri campus, aligning courses with AICTE model curriculum changes.

articles.headline: Eye care hospital inaugurated at Kalavara near Udupi
articles.blurb: A new eye-care hospital opened at Kalavara near Udupi, offering cataract surgery, glaucoma screening and outreach camps for rural patients.

articles.headline: Apsara ruled hearts and minds when they landed in Udipi resort for shooting
articles.blurb: A television serial crew including actors promoted as 'Apsaras' shot scenes at a Udupi resort, drawing crowds of onlookers during the Mangaluru-area schedule.

articles.headline: Tigalas celebrate Dasara in their traditional style
articles.blurb: Tigala community members in Mangaluru celebrated Dasara with traditional processions, doll displays and community feasts in their neighbourhoods.

articles.headline: Yet another wine parlour in Dharmasthala, Sanidhi shuts its doors
articles.blurb: A wine parlour near Dharmasthala closed while another outlet opened on the highway, reflecting shifting liquor retail patterns around the pilgrim town in Dakshina Kannada.

articles.headline: Absent minded servicemen drew flak after women delivered Rajyotsava award to safai workers
articles.blurb: Mangaluru civic officials faced criticism after women volunteers had to hand Karnataka Rajyotsava awards to pourakarmikas when designated officers were absent from the city corporation ceremony.

articles.headline: Fire broke out at Saravu complex at Bunder road, 3 shops gutted
articles.blurb: A fire at Saravu commercial complex on Bunder Road destroyed three shops before firefighters contained the blaze; preliminary reports pointed to an electrical short circuit.

articles.headline: Railway, a fitting reply to age-old demand for a separate coach in Mangaluru-SC train
articles.blurb: South Western Railway attached a dedicated coach on the Mangaluru–Secunderabad express, meeting a long-standing demand from coastal passengers for reserved accommodation.

articles.headline: Limited height JCB machine violates road rule at Brahmavar
articles.blurb: Police fined a contractor after an over-height JCB damaged overhead utilities on a Brahmavar road, violating movement restrictions for heavy equipment.

articles.headline: BJP national executive meet proclaims 'Ab KII Baar BJP Sarkar' in Karnataka
articles.blurb: BJP leaders at a national executive session in Karnataka reiterated the slogan 'Ab KII Baar BJP Sarkar', outlining campaign themes for upcoming local and state polls.

articles.headline: Coffee growers, planters in Kodagu take to streets in Kushalnagar demanding govt support
articles.blurb: Coffee growers and planters blocked roads in Kushalnagar, Kodagu, demanding higher support prices, pest-control aid and relief after erratic rains hit yields.

articles.headline: Weavers of the entire belt breathe a sigh of relief after new rates for handloom products
articles.blurb: Handloom weavers in Udupi district welcomed revised state procurement rates for sarees and yardage, saying the hike eases rising yarn and dye costs.

articles.headline: Eight drains inaugurated to reduce flooding at Kottara, Padil
articles.blurb: Mangaluru City Corporation inaugurated eight storm-water drains in Kottara and Padil wards, aiming to cut monsoon flooding that routinely inundates low-lying streets.

articles.headline: Justice Sanjeev Khanna expected to be the next Chief Justice of India
articles.blurb: Legal circles expect Justice Sanjeev Khanna to succeed as Chief Justice of India following the retirement schedule of the incumbent, citing his seniority on the Supreme Court collegium.

articles.headline: Famous Happy Datta priest no more
articles.blurb: The priest known as Happy Datta, who conducted popular bhajans in Kundapura, died after illness; devotees gathered for his funeral rites along the coast.

articles.headline: Akademi awards announced - 7 Kannada litterateurs
articles.blurb: Karnataka Sahitya Akademi announced awards for seven Kannada writers across poetry, criticism and translation categories for works published in the last year.

articles.headline: Konkani associations to collect funds for relief material for Wayanad and Kodagu
articles.blurb: Konkani associations in coastal Karnataka launched a fund drive to send relief kits to landslide-affected Wayanad and flood-hit Kodagu families.

articles.headline: Inauguration of cricket academy at Karkala on Friday evening
articles.blurb: A cricket coaching academy will be inaugurated at Karkala on Friday evening, offering nets and fitness training for youth players from Udupi district.

articles.headline: Lokayukta court remands Dy SP to five days custody in land scam
articles.blurb: A Lokayukta court sent a deputy superintendent of police to five days judicial custody in a Bengaluru land-allotment scam being probed by anti-corruption police.

articles.headline: Anti-drug campaign launched in Mangaluru
articles.blurb: City police and NGOs launched an anti-drug awareness campaign in Mangaluru schools and colleges, highlighting penalties under the NDPS Act and counselling helplines.

articles.headline: SIDS accounts for about 50% of sudden infant deaths, awareness programme
articles.blurb: Health workers in Mangaluru held an awareness talk noting that sudden infant death syndrome accounts for roughly half of unexplained infant deaths, urging safe sleep practices.

articles.headline: Gabriel Coutinho bags top honours in football tourney
articles.blurb: Gabriel Coutinho of a Mangaluru club was adjudged best player at a local football tournament after leading his side with multiple goals in the final rounds.

articles.headline: IG visits airport, holds meeting with top officials over security arrangements
articles.blurb: Inspector General of Police visited Mangaluru International Airport for a security review with CISF and airport officials ahead of the festive passenger rush.

articles.headline: Cricket workshop at Udyavara, Kundapur on Nov 2
articles.blurb: Coaches will conduct a cricket skills workshop at Udyavara, Kundapur, on November 2 for under-16 players from coastal academies.

articles.headline: Hijab-wearing woman arrested on 'suspicious grounds' Gaza
articles.blurb: Egyptian authorities detained a Gaza woman wearing hijab on suspicion of document irregularities as she attempted to cross a checkpoint, amid tightened border controls.

articles.headline: WhatsApp surpasses 3 billion users
articles.blurb: Meta said WhatsApp crossed three billion monthly active users worldwide, extending its lead among messaging apps despite competition from rivals.

articles.headline: London museum returns 32 looted Asante gold artefacts
articles.blurb: The British Museum returned 32 gold artefacts looted from Ghana's Asante kingdom in the 19th century, following negotiations with Ghanaian officials.

articles.headline: RCB women's team enters auction for WPL
articles.blurb: Royal Challengers Bengaluru prepared to bid for players in the Women's Premier League auction, retaining core Indian internationals ahead of the player pool draw.

articles.headline: LS research shows govt sector accounts for 56% of employment
articles.blurb: A Lok Sabha research note cited in the paper said government and public sector still account for about 56% of formal employment in India, despite private-sector growth.

articles.headline: Mangaluru safest airport to land
articles.blurb: Aviation data cited in the paper ranked Mangaluru International Airport among the safest for challenging tabletop landings, noting improved runway safety systems.

articles.headline: After first successful summit, govt plans another investment event at Hubballi
articles.blurb: Karnataka will host another global investors meet in Hubballi after the first summit secured memoranda worth thousands of crores, officials said.

articles.headline: ISRO invited to share space expertise with Islamic countries
articles.blurb: ISRO received invitations to brief Islamic nations on satellite launches and remote sensing during a multilateral space cooperation forum in West Asia.

articles.headline: Sri Lanka economy staggers after seventh IMF programme ends
articles.blurb: Sri Lanka faces renewed currency pressure after its seventh IMF programme ended, with inflation and debt repayments worrying Colombo traders.

articles.headline: Berlin patient loses HIV after stem cell transplant
articles.blurb: Physicians reported the 'Berlin patient' remained free of detectable HIV years after a stem-cell transplant, renewing research into cure strategies.

articles.headline: Trivandrum to host 4-day Hindu conclave from Oct 17
articles.blurb: A four-day Hindu leadership conclave opens in Thiruvananthapuram on October 17, with organisers expecting saints and scholars from several states.

articles.headline: Browns QB Shedeur Sanders makes NFL history
articles.blurb: Cleveland Browns quarterback Shedeur Sanders became the first rookie in team history to throw for 300 yards in his debut start, the paper reported from NFL wire copy.

articles.headline: Literature festival explores the word power
articles.blurb: A coastal literature festival panel discussed how poetry and translation shape public discourse, featuring Kannada and English authors in Mangaluru.

articles.headline: Zomato delivery man steals customer's Kiwis
articles.blurb: Police in Rajasthan arrested a Zomato delivery partner after a customer accused him of stealing kiwis from a grocery order captured on CCTV.

articles.headline: Parag Nayak receives Berhampur ratna award
articles.blurb: Mangaluru-origin student Parag Nayak received Berhampur University's 'Ratna' award for academic excellence during a convocation in Odisha.

articles.headline: Cyber fraud of Rs 11.88 lakh, SBI manager under lens
articles.blurb: Bihar police registered a case over an alleged ₹11.88 lakh cyber fraud, questioning an SBI branch manager about delayed blocking of a suspicious transaction.

articles.headline: Kerala plans action against illegal rat-hole mining
articles.blurb: Kerala government said it will crack down on illegal rat-hole coal mining after tunnel collapses endangered workers in the state's eastern hills.

articles.headline: Cow on NH4 brings traffic to standstill
articles.blurb: A stray cow wandering onto NH-4 near Pune halted traffic for an hour until highway police and locals guided the animal off the carriageway.

articles.headline: Brazil World Cup viewers injured
articles.blurb: Several fans were injured in a crush outside a São Paulo fan zone during a Brazil World Cup qualifier screening, local media reported.

articles.headline: Businessman ends life after marital dispute in Belagavi
articles.blurb: A Belagavi businessman died by suicide after a marital dispute, leaving a note asking police to investigate harassment claims against his in-laws.

articles.headline: Lumpy skin disease wreaks havoc
articles.blurb: Veterinary officials said lumpy skin disease continues to kill cattle across multiple states, with farmers demanding faster vaccination drives.

articles.headline: Woman becomes pregnant after hysterectomy
articles.blurb: Doctors in Himachal Pradesh reported a rare case where a woman conceived after a prior hysterectomy, prompting a hospital review of surgical records.

articles.headline: AI-generated deepfake priest
articles.blurb: Italian church authorities warned parishioners about an AI-generated deepfake video of a priest soliciting donations online.

articles.headline: Physiotherapy camp organized by RAPCC
articles.blurb: Rotary Academy of Physiotherapy and Community Care conducted a free physiotherapy camp in Mangaluru for seniors and accident survivors.

articles.headline: JCI team Bantwal conducts study tour
articles.blurb: JCI Bantwal members toured local industries and schools on a study tour to identify community service projects in Bantwal taluk.

articles.headline: Kannada Rajyotsava celebrated at SKBR College Sullia
articles.blurb: SKBR College, Sullia, marked Karnataka Rajyotsava with flag hoisting, Kannada literary competitions and honours for meritorious students.

articles.headline: Heritage walk on Royal Enfield bikes in Coorg
articles.blurb: Heritage enthusiasts rode Royal Enfield motorcycles through Kodagu coffee estates on a guided history ride organised by a Madikeri club.

articles.headline: Minister Nalin Kumar Kateel reacts to Maha Raigad controversy
articles.blurb: Mangaluru MP Nalin Kumar Kateel said Karnataka BJP has no link to the Maharashtra Raigad political controversy, accusing opponents of dragging his name without evidence.

articles.headline: Mangaluru Union Christian College celebrates AHM annual fest
articles.blurb: Union Christian College, Mangaluru, hosted its annual AHM fest with debates, music and art exhibitions across departments.

articles.headline: Nepal football delegation in Kolkata
articles.blurb: A Nepal football association delegation met IFA officials in Kolkata to schedule friendly matches and training camps for junior national sides.

articles.headline: Women's organization observes World Mental Health Day at Kundapura
articles.blurb: A Kundapura women's group marked World Mental Health Day with counselling stalls and talks on postpartum depression in coastal villages.

articles.headline: CM Siddaramaiah condoled deaths of innocent victims in Bali tragedy in Indonesia
articles.blurb: Chief Minister Siddaramaiah expressed condolences over the deaths of innocent people in the recent Bali tragedy in Indonesia, issuing a statement urging peace and support for affected families.

articles.headline: Dowry harassment claim lands husband in police custody Hassan
articles.blurb: Hassan police arrested a man after his wife alleged dowry harassment and assault, registering a case under IPC and Dowry Prohibition Act sections.

articles.headline: Steps to conserve tiger population in India
articles.blurb: Environment ministry officials outlined Project Tiger census methods and habitat corridor plans as India reported a modest rise in big-cat numbers.

articles.headline: Newborn abandoned in autorickshaw Uttar Pradesh
articles.blurb: Passengers found a newborn girl abandoned in an autorickshaw in Uttar Pradesh; police traced the mother and admitted the infant to hospital.

articles.headline: Hornets sign LaMelo Ball to shoe deal
articles.blurb: Charlotte Hornets guard LaMelo Ball signed a multi-year footwear endorsement with a global brand, the NBA wire brief said.

articles.headline: Jammy requests for touching Dhoni's shirt
articles.blurb: Fans at a Jharkhand event swarmed MS Dhoni for autographs, with one child viral for asking to touch the cricketer's match shirt.

articles.headline: Mumma entrepreneurs launch papad unit at Udupi
articles.blurb: A women's self-help group in Udupi inaugurated a papad-making unit, selling 'Mumma' brand wafers to local grocers and temple stalls.
